INC-0841.title: Finance Controller accessed production secrets while on PIP
INC-0841.description: A finance controller currently on a Performance Improvement Plan (PIP) accessed production secrets stored in the secrets manager at 09:14. This access pattern is anomalous — the user has never previously accessed this resource. Cross-correlation with HR signals indicates this user is flagged for involuntary termination review. Immediate access review is recommended.

INC-0840.title: Ransomware-pattern file encryption on WIN-FIN-04
INC-0840.description: Rapid file encryption burst detected on WIN-FIN-04 matching MITRE T1486 (Data Encrypted for Impact). The process initiated at 08:57 and encrypted 147 files in 4 minutes. Network share \\finance-nas\reports was also targeted. The device has been flagged for immediate isolation.
